verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own marketing page describes a built-in 'campaign agent' that users can hand a goal to and have plan an entire campaign. It also describes AI generation of blog posts, social content and landing pages, and AI rewriting of nurture emails per contact, which shows in-product delegation of real tasks. The evidence is limited to one-line marketing claims, with no docs on how the assistant is invoked, what it can act on, or how users review its work. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the AI assistant's interface and task scope, evidence of a general conversational assistant beyond the campaign agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
Create blog posts, social content, and landing pages grounded in your brand voice, audience data, and competitor research.
Rewrite every nurture email for the specific contact receiving it, using their CRM data, behavior, and live company research.
